identity.name: Tank Must

case.bezel: no bezel — polished steel case, interchangeable strap system

identity.one_liner: The relaunched entry point into the Tank line, pairing a steel quartz case with a tool-free interchangeable strap system rather than reviving one specific vintage Tank reference.

narrative.story: Cartier relaunched the Tank Must in 2021 as a lower-priced reworking of the Tank Solo, built in steel and fitted with a quartz movement rather than mechanical, which keeps the price well below the brand's mechanical Tank references. The line uses a tool-free interchangeable strap system that lets an owner swap colors without a watchmaker, a departure from the fixed-strap approach used on Cartier's higher Tank tiers.
narrative.collector_notes: Confirm whether a listing is quartz (Tank Must) or automatic (Tank Solo/Louis Cartier) before comparing prices — movement type is the main functional split within the broader Tank range, and secondary-market pricing reflects it.
